summary: LogProstyle Inc., a Tokyo-based NYSE American-listed real estate firm, closed its acquisition of 100% of the equity of I-FLATZ Co., LTD., a Kansai condominium sales, renovation and leasing company, on September 28, 2026, per this Form 6-K. The deal was first disclosed August 27, 2026, with the Share Purchase Agreement; that filing carried the material terms. No price, premium or consideration details appear in this closing notice. I-FLATZ and subsidiary LAND-I become consolidated subsidiaries; existing management stays to execute integration and synergies. Watch integration execution and Kansai expansion economics.
